# The Debate Club

> A neutral community platform for civil public discourse. We host live online voice debates every Saturday at 11am IST (Indian Standard Time) on community-suggested, member-voted topics. Free to join. Open to anyone.

The Debate Club exists to enable bi-directional public discourse. Most of today's public conversation runs on a broadcaster-and-consumer model — a small number of publishers push out a narrative and the rest of the audience consumes it without an avenue to shape it. We exist to flip that: a neutral facilitator where people from any perspective can show up and actually be heard, in good faith, on the topics that shape public conversation.

## How the community works

- We meet **online** for live voice debates every **Saturday at 11am IST**.
- The live conversation happens in our **WhatsApp Community**.
- The schedule of upcoming debates lives on our **Meetup page**.
- Topic selection is community-driven:
  1. Anyone fills out the topic-suggestion form.
  2. We periodically run polls in the WhatsApp group.
  3. Winning topics are scheduled on Meetup.
  4. The Saturday session debates them live.

We are a **neutral platform** — we facilitate the conversation; we do not endorse any side of it. The views expressed by participants in our sessions are those of the participants and not of The Debate Club as a platform.

## FAQ (canonical answers)

**What is The Debate Club?**
A community for civil public discourse. We meet online for live voice debates every Saturday at 11am IST on community-chosen topics.

**When and where?**
Saturdays, 11am Indian Standard Time, in our WhatsApp Community. The schedule is on our Meetup page.

**How are topics chosen?**
Anyone suggests topics via our form; the community votes in WhatsApp polls; winners are scheduled on Meetup.

**How do I join?**
Join the WhatsApp Community. That's where everything happens.

**Do I need debate experience?**
No. All experience levels are welcome.

**Is it free?**
Yes. The Debate Club is free and open to all.
